subject: StratusAI: Marketplace metering, entitlement proofing & SaaS fulfillment
messages:
From: Samir Patel <samir.patel@stratus.ai>
To: olga_petrov <olga_petrov@redwood.com>, kimberly_park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>
Cc: AWS Marketplace Onboarding <marketplace-onboarding@amazon.com>
Date: Thu, 09 Oct 2025 09:15:00 -0700
Subject: StratusAI - Marketplace metering & SaaS fulfillment steps

Hi Olga / Kimberly,

Thanks again for taking the call this morning. Per our conversation at StratusAI, we're ready to move from contract signature to the AWS Marketplace metering & fulfillment integration. We just executed the Master SaaS Agreement and attached the SOW for reference (StratusAI_SaaS_SOW.pdf).

To avoid back-and-forth with our procurement team, can you confirm the exact list of artifacts your fulfillment team needs to validate entitlement and start pilot ingestion? Specifically we want to know:
- Required contract metadata (Seller ID, SKU mapping format)
- Preferred entitlement schema (seat vs. usage tiers) and example CSV/JSON
- Webhook endpoint and auth expectations for usage events (headers, replay window)
- Test environment URL and sample payloads to validate signing and timestamping
- Any evidence needed for billing (invoice contact, legal justification)

We also need an estimate for how long the verification window typically takes once we hand off artifacts (target: pilot go-live week of Oct 20). Can you route this back to anyone on your legal/billing team?

Attaching SOW and our internal procurement checklist for quick reference.

Appreciate the help — Samir

Attachments: StratusAI_SaaS_SOW.pdf, StratusAI_Procurement_Checklist.xlsx

From: olga_petrov <olga_petrov@redwood.com>
To: Samir Patel <samir.patel@stratus.ai>
Cc: kimberly_park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>, marketplace-onboarding@amazon.com
Date: Thu, 09 Oct 2025 11:02:00 -0700
Subject: Re: StratusAI - Marketplace metering & SaaS fulfillment steps

Hi Samir — thanks for the note and congrats on the signed SOW. Short answers below and a list of next steps to keep the handoff tight.

What we need from you (minimum deliverables):
1) Contract metadata: PDF of signed SOW + executed MSA; Seller ID (AWS) and preferred SKU IDs for each product.
2) Entitlement mapping: one-row-per-customer CSV or JSON with columns: customer_id, sku, entitlement_type, quantity, start_date, end_date, billing_contact_email. If you plan to do tiered metering, flag tiers in the schema.
3) Webhook & ingestion: a test endpoint + shared HMAC secret. Sample payloads attached (metering-webhook-sample.json). Redwood expects x-amz-marketplace-token header for marketplace-originated requests; for SaaS metering we verify HMAC signature (sha256). Replay window = 5 minutes by default; we can adjust if you have specific clock skew concerns.
4) Billing/Invoice contact: person and email for settlement correspondence. Also specify whether invoices are monthly/quarterly and any specific invoice fields.

Our internal timeline and owners:
- Redwood Fulfillment Team (Kimberly) will validate entitlement mapping and confirm SKU mapping to marketplace SKUs (estimated 2 business days once we have the CSV).
- Billing ops (Marcus) will verify invoicing requirements and Seller ID handshake (1-3 business days).
- We will do a single-tenant pilot ingestion to a test Seller account; once successful we schedule production cutover.

Next steps I recommend:
1) Samir: upload the CSV/JSON entitlement mapping and attach the test webhook + secret to a secure drive link (or paste the sample if small).
2) Kimberly: I'll loop you in here to confirm Seller ID and any marketplace-specific format.
3) Marcus: please advise on invoice fields and whether we need a purchase order for the pilot.

I'll attach a small sample webhook payload and the minimal mapping template. If you want, we can run a 30-minute technical handoff with our engineering ops tomorrow.

Best,
Olga Petrov
Head of Marketplace Integrations
Redwood Inference

Attachments: metering-webhook-sample.json, entitlement-mapping-template.csv
